text:
Propan-1-ol is oxidised by acidified aqueous potassium manganate(VII) in a similar way to
ethanol.
Which compound is produced by the oxidation of propan-1-ol with acidified aqueous
potassium manganate(VII)?
A
CH3CH2OH
B
CH3CH2CH2OH
C
CH3COOH
D
CH3CH2COOH
